scripts.dev:all: npm run infra:up && STOP_INFRA=1 bash scripts/dev.sh
scripts.dev:raw: concurrently -n server,storefront -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w storefront"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w storefront
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,storefront -c blue,magenta "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w storefront"
scripts.test: npm run test:storefront && npm run test:embedder
scripts.test:embedder: docker compose -f apps/server/docker-compose.yml run --rm --no-deps embedder python -m pytest tests/ -q
scripts.verify: npm run check-types && npm run lint && npm run test
